description: Enhanced HTTP transport and status mapping: GET with named integer overload and string id, http_post success of a void/integer method, http_post notification (empty body), custom provider remapping an unmapped service error and an internal/error-not-handled category, and a custom-provider GET success remap.

cases.expected_output:
http_status=200
content_type=application/json-rpc
jsonrpc=2.0
id=5
outcome=success
result=42

cases.description: POST voidMethod success is 200 with null result
cases.expected_output:
http_status=200
content_type=application/json-rpc
jsonrpc=2.0
id=6
outcome=success
result=null

http_status=200
content_type=application/json-rpc
jsonrpc=2.0
id=3
outcome=success
result="overloaded:int:7"

cases.description: GET unknown method over HTTP is 404
cases.expected_output:
http_status=404
content_type=application/json-rpc
jsonrpc=2.0
id=4
outcome=error
error_code=-32601
error_category=method_not_found
error_message=method not found

cases.description: custom provider remaps an unmapped service error
cases.expected_output:
http_status=1006
content_type=application/json-rpc
jsonrpc=2.0
id=1
outcome=error
error_code=-32001
error_category=error_not_handled

cases.description: custom provider remaps a parse error
cases.expected_output:
http_status=1002
content_type=application/json-rpc
jsonrpc=2.0
id="null"
outcome=error
error_code=-32700
error_category=parse_error
error_message=JSON parse error

cases.description: custom provider remaps a batch containing an error
cases.expected_output:
http_status=1005
content_type=application/json-rpc
batch_size=2
--
jsonrpc=2.0
id=1
outcome=error
error_code=-32001
error_category=error_not_handled
--
jsonrpc=2.0
id=2
outcome=success
result="ok"

cases.description: POST mapped custom-code service error is 500
cases.expected_output:
http_status=200
content_type=application/json-rpc
jsonrpc=2.0
id=1
outcome=error
error_code=1234
error_category=custom
